title: Human Resource Manager
description:
Position: HR Manager, Sr. HR Manager
 Department: Human Resources & Administration
 Location: Sankagiri, Salem District, Tamil Nadu
 Reports To: General Manager / Managing Director Job Summary We are looking for an experienced and responsible HR Manager to manage the complete Human Resources and Administration functions of the organization. The HR Manager will be responsible for manpower planning, recruitment, employee relations, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, performance management, training, attendance, and overall HR operations. Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment & Manpower Planning Manage the complete recruitment and selection process from sourcing to joining. Identify manpower requirements in coordination with department heads. Prepare job descriptions and publish vacancies through appropriate recruitment portals. Screen applications, conduct interviews, and coordinate with management for final selection. Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, and joining documentation. Maintain recruitment records and manpower status. 2. Employee Relations Handle employee grievances and workplace-related issues professionally. Maintain healthy communication between employees and management. Address disciplinary matters, absenteeism, misconduct, and workplace conflicts. Conduct employee counselling and support employee engagement activities. Ensure proper implementation of company HR policies and procedures. 3. Attendance & Leave Management Monitor employee attendance, leave, late coming, absenteeism, and shift schedules. Coordinate with the Time Office and department heads regarding attendance issues. Maintain accurate employee attendance and leave records. Ensure timely submission of attendance inputs for payroll processing. 4. Payroll & Compensation Coordinate monthly payroll processing with the Accounts/Finance Department. Verify salary, attendance, deductions, incentives, overtime, and other payroll inputs. Handle salary revisions, increments, promotions, and employee compensation records. Maintain accurate employee salary and statutory deduction records. 5. Statutory Compliance Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements. Coordinate matters relating to PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Professional Tax, Minimum Wages, Shops & Establishments, Factories Act , and other applicable regulations. Maintain statutory registers, records, notices, and documentation. Coordinate with consultants and government authorities whenever required. 6. Training & Development Identify employee training requirements in consultation with department heads. Organize induction and orientation programmes for new employees. Coordinate technical, behavioural, safety, and product-related training programmes. Maintain training records and evaluate training effectiveness. 7. Performance Management Coordinate employee performance appraisal and review processes. Support department heads in setting performance objectives and evaluating employees. Manage promotion, increment, confirmation, transfer, and performance-related documentation. 8. HR Policies & Documentation Develop, implement, and periodically review HR policies and procedures. Maintain employee personal files and confidential HR records. Ensure proper documentation of appointment, confirmation, promotion, transfer, disciplinary action, and separation. Prepare HR reports, MIS, manpower reports, and management updates. 9. Administration Oversee general HR and administrative activities. Coordinate facilities such as security, canteen, transport, housekeeping, uniforms, ID cards, and employee welfare facilities. Monitor contract labour and manpower-related administrative activities. Coordinate employee welfare programmes and company events. 10. Separation & Exit Management Manage resignation, notice period, relieving, and full-and-final settlement processes. Conduct exit interviews where required. Ensure proper handover and clearance procedures before employee separation. Coordinate issuance of relieving and experience certificates. Key Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of HR practices and labour laws. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong employee-handling and conflict-resolution abilities. Good knowledge of payroll and statutory compliance. Good working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, HRMS, and recruitment portals . Leadership and team-management skills. Strong documentation and reporting skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Decision-making and problem-solving abilities. Ability to work independently and coordinate with senior management. Qualification MBA / PGDM in Human Resource Management preferred. Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline. Additional certification in HR / Labour Laws will be an advantage. Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience in HR & Administration , preferably in a manufacturing or industrial organization. Candidates with experience in handling factory manpower, contract labour, statutory compliance, recruitment, payroll, and employee relations will be preferred. Key Performance Areas (KPIs) Recruitment and manpower fulfilment Employee retention and engagement Attendance and absenteeism management Payroll accuracy and timely processing Statutory compliance Training and employee development HR documentation and MIS reporting Employee grievance resolution Discipline and policy implementation Overall HR & Administration efficiency

title: Human Resource Business Partner
description:
Were Hiring | Regional HRBP Delhi / North Region 
 We are looking for an experienced Regional HRBP to lead and drive HR initiatives across the Delhi/North region . 
 The role will partner closely with business and operations teams and will be responsible for managing a large, multi-location workforce covering both blue-collar and white-collar employees . The focus will be on manpower availability, workforce productivity, employee engagement, compliance, and overall HR effectiveness. 
 Key Responsibilities & Success Metrics 1. Business Partnering & Workforce Strategy Partner with Regional and Operations Heads to align HR initiatives with business goals, productivity, and cost efficiency. Drive manpower planning and maintain 95%+ manpower fill rate within 57 days TAT . Maintain an 80%+ offer-to-joining ratio . 
 2. Workforce Management & Productivity Manage high-volume blue-collar and white-collar workforce across multiple hubs/sites. Maintain 95%+ attendance compliance . Control absenteeism to below 8% . Optimize overtime by 1015% . Ensure workforce availability is aligned with operational requirements. 
 3. Talent Acquisition & Deployment Work closely with the TA team to ensure timely hiring for frontline and corporate positions. Drive quick onboarding and deployment to avoid manpower gaps and operational disruptions. 
 4. Vendor & Contract Workforce Management Manage and govern manpower agencies with 95%+ SLA adherence . Ensure 100% billing accuracy and proper validation before processing. Ensure statutory compliance across vendors, including PF, ESIC and CLRA . 
 5. Employee Relations & IR Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and conflict-resolution cases. Ensure closure of cases within 35 working days . Maintain a stable and positive employee relations environment across operational sites. 
 6. Compliance & HR Operations Ensure zero major statutory non-compliance across the region. Maintain 95%+ audit scores across locations. Validate payroll inputs and maintain less than 1% payroll error rate . Ensure 100% accuracy of employee data and HR records . 
 7. Performance & Productivity Drive performance management processes across the region. Partner with Operations to identify productivity gaps and implement improvement initiatives. Track workforce productivity and support business teams in achieving operational targets. 
 8. Engagement & Retention Manage attrition and identify key retention drivers across blue- and white-collar teams. Maintain 85%+ new-joiner retention at 90 days . Drive employee engagement initiatives with 80%+ workforce participation . Work closely with business leaders to improve employee experience and retention. 
 9. MIS & HR Analytics Publish accurate and timely HR dashboards and MIS reports. Provide data-driven insights to leadership for workforce planning and decision-making. Track key HR metrics including manpower, attrition, absenteeism, hiring, joining, attendance, productivity, and employee relations. 
 Key Requirements MBA / PGDM in Human Resources 6–12 years of experience in HRBP / Regional HR roles. Experience in Logistics / Supply Chain / Warehousing / E-commerce will be preferred. Strong experience in managing large, multi-location blue-collar and white-collar workforces . Strong knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance . Experience in vendor and contract workforce management . Strong exposure to HR operations, employee relations, manpower planning, and HR analytics. 
 Key Competencies Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills High ownership and execution focus Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution abilities Data-driven approach to HR Ability to work in a fast-paced, operational environment Strong communication and people-management skills 
 Additional Requirement Willingness to travel extensively across the region . Comfortable working across warehouses, hubs, field locations, and operational sites . Location: Delhi / North Region

title: Manager -Marketing
description:
To drive high-quality, timely and consistent execution of the Groups marketing initiatives across businesses, locations and channels. Working closely with the GM Marketing, the role will translate approved marketing strategies and plans into effective execution. The incumbent will be the key execution interface between internal business teams, creative and content teams, agencies and vendors, taking ownership of marketing deliverables from brief to completion. The role will provide significant exposure to different aspects of marketing and an opportunity to progressively build broader marketing capabilities under the guidance of the GM – Marketing. Key Responsibilities 
 1. Campaign Execution Translate approved marketing plans into execution calendars, timelines and deliverables. Coordinate rollout of campaigns across relevant online and offline channels. Ensure timely and consistent execution across businesses and locations. Proactively follow up on dependencies and drive deliverables to closure. 
 2. Creative, Content & Marketing Collaterals Develop briefs and coordinate creation of marketing communication across channels. Manage brochures, presentations, advertisements, digital and social media creatives, videos, signage and other marketing collaterals. Coordinate website and social media content requirements. Ensure consistency of brand, messaging and quality across all communication. 
 3. Events, Activations & Local Marketing Execute launches, events, exhibitions, customer engagement programmes, local marketing initiatives and activations. Coordinate branding, communication, production, collateral, logistics and on-ground execution. Ensure high-quality and timely delivery across locations. 
 4. Agency & Vendor Management Manage day-to-day coordination with creative, content, PR, event, production and other marketing agencies/vendors. Provide clear briefs, timelines and deliverables and ensure timely closure. Coordinate quotations, production and deliverables within approved budgets. Monitor quality and performance of agencies and vendors. 
 5. Cross-functional Marketing Coordination Work closely with Sales, Operations and Business teams to understand and fulfil approved marketing requirements. Coordinate marketing initiatives across businesses and locations. Act as the central point for follow-up between internal stakeholders and external partners. Maintain execution calendars and trackers and keep the GM – Marketing updated on progress, delays and issues. 
 What Success Looks Like Strong execution discipline; high-quality marketing output delivered on time; consistent brand communication; effective coordination across internal teams, agencies and vendors; adherence to approved budgets; and proactive ownership of deliverables from brief to closure.

title: Manager - Finance
description:
Role: Manager- Finance Designation: Manager Base location: Kinshasa Reporting To: Vice President Finance 
 What you become a part of: The Manager/Sr. Manager - Finance will be leading day-to-day finance and accounting operations for Shalinas business in DRC, covering financial planning, budgeting, business partnering, treasury, statutory compliance, and internal controls. The role will work closely with OU leadership and the central finance team to drive financial discipline, profitability, cash-flow efficiency, and compliance with applicable local regulations and corporate policies. 
 Role & responsibilities Business Partnering & Financial Planning Partner with OU leadership and commercial teams to provide financial insights and support business decisions. Prepare and analyze budgets, forecasts, AOP, and periodic financial projections; monitor performance against plan and highlight variances. Recommend product pricing actions considering cost movements, foreign exchange fluctuations, profitability, and PBT performance against AOP. Analyze product and channel mix, discounts, customer incentives, and other commercial levers to identify opportunities for improving profitability. Evaluate ROI for major marketing spends, CAPEX, new shops, vehicles, and other business investments. Review credit limits, customer exposure, and receivables; identify underutilized limits and opportunities to support business growth while managing credit risk. Ensure accurate evaluation and timely posting of credit notes and customer incentives. Identify cost-saving opportunities and drive process improvements and automation. Financial Reporting & Monthly Closing Ensure timely and accurate monthly financial closing, submission of financial statements, MIS, and closing checklists. Prepare and review P&L, balance sheet, cash-flow statements, and management reports. Conduct periodic balance sheet reviews, identify risks, and address under-provisions, excess provisions, and reconciliation issues. Analyze actual performance against budgets and forecasts, providing actionable insights to management. Track and close action items arising from management reviews. Ensure accurate product costing, inventory valuation, and financial reporting. Treasury & Forex Management Manage daily funds, cash-flow forecasts, and working capital requirements. Ensure timely settlement of overseas supplier payments and forex remittances in line with approved policies and business requirements. Monitor foreign exchange movements and identify opportunities to optimize forex sourcing and blended exchange rates. Manage banking relationships, fund-based and non-fund-based facilities, and related documentation. Identify opportunities to reduce interest and banking costs, including negotiation of improved interest rates. Minimize idle funds and ensure efficient deployment of available cash. Drive adoption of online banking and efficient treasury processes. Evaluate available forex risk mitigation and hedging mechanisms in coordination with central finance. Statutory Compliance & Audit Ensure timely and accurate filing of statutory returns, tax returns, annual accounts, and other regulatory submissions applicable in DRC. Ensure compliance with local tax laws, statutory requirements, and company policies. Reconcile statutory books with management accounts and investigate discrepancies. Review transfer pricing and intercompany transactions; coordinate with Head Office Finance on pricing recommendations and implementation. Manage relationships with statutory authorities, tax regulators, banks, and internal and external auditors. Coordinate statutory and internal audits, ensure timely submission of information, and drive closure of audit observations. Support appropriate tax planning while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Internal Controls & Process Governance Ensure adherence to corporate finance policies, procedures, approval matrices, and internal control requirements. Establish and maintain effective controls across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, procurement, inventory, and cash management. Ensure regular independent stock and cash audits across locations, at least quarterly, and follow up on identified discrepancies. Develop and implement SOPs for AP, AR, procurement, and other relevant finance processes. Identify segregation-of-duties gaps and implement appropriate checks and controls. Monitor debtor ageing, credit control, supplier reconciliations, and timely settlement of obligations. Ensure accurate financial records, reconciliations, and supporting documentation. Team & Stakeholder Management Lead, guide, and develop the local finance and accounts team. Work closely with the central finance team and cross-functional stakeholders, including Commercial, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations. Promote financial awareness, accountability, and disciplined adherence to processes across the business. Provide timely financial updates, analysis, and recommendations to OU leadership and Head Office. 
 Preferred candidate profile Education: Bachelors degree in finance, Accounting, or a related discipline; MBA in Finance or a professional accounting qualification such as CA/ICWA/ACCA or equivalent will be an advantage. Experience: 15+ Years of experience as finance controller in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, FMCG, retail, or consumer goods industry preferred. Prior experience working in African markets is preferred. Significant experience in finance and accounting, including leadership responsibilities in a business or regional finance function. Strong experience in financial planning and analysis, budgeting, MIS, P&L management, cash-flow management, forex, costing, credit control, and statutory compliance. Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP or equivalent is required. Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and multicultural teams. Skills & Attributes Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting Business Partnering & Commercial Finance P&L Management and Financial Analysis Treasury, Cash Flow & Forex Management Product Costing, Pricing & Profitability Analysis Credit Control and Working Capital Management Statutory Compliance, Taxation & Audit Internal Controls, SOPs & Risk Management ERP Systems and Advanced MS Excel Team Leadership and Stakeholder Management Analytical Thinking, Ownership, and Execution Success Measures / KPIs Timely and accurate monthly financial closing and MIS submission. Budget and AOP monitoring, variance analysis, and financial performance visibility. Product profitability and cost optimization initiatives. Cash-flow efficiency, working capital management, and forex cost control. Timely statutory filings and closure of audit observations. Compliance with internal controls, policies, and approval processes. Timely completion of credit reviews, reconciliations, and management action items. Finance team effectiveness and stakeholder support. Behavioral Competencies High ownership and accountability Ability to work in a fast-paced, cost-driven environment Cross-cultural collaboration skills Problem-solving under constraints Strong execution focus

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division,leveragingthis globallogisticsleader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express andlogisticssolutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grownlogisticsplayer with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder. We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work , combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal;it’sa fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour. If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition. Position Overview: The Associate Territory Manager – Sales is responsible for driving revenue growth and commercial performance across Blue Dart's retail and counter network within an assigned territory. The role focuses on maximizing counter business, increasing walk-in customer conversion, developing business from the local catchment, promoting Blue Dart's domestic and international products and value-added services, and improving productivity across touchpoints. Working closely with the Cluster Manager – and cross-functional Operations and Customer Service teams, the role will ensure that each retail touchpoint contributes effectively to revenue growth while consistently delivering Blue Dart's service and customer experience standards. Job Purpose: To drive profitable sales growth within the assigned territory by maximizing counter revenue, increasing customer acquisition and repeat business, developing the surrounding retail catchment, improving product mix and counter productivity, and ensuring a consistently high-quality customer experience across Blue Dart retail touchpoints. Key Roles & Responsibilities: Sales Revenue & Business Growth Achieve monthly and annual revenue and shipment targets for the assigned territory. Drive revenue growth across Blue Dart retail counters and other assigned touchpoints. Track counter-wise revenue, shipment volumes and productivity and identify opportunities for improvement. Increase business from existing customers while continuously developing new sources of revenue. Drive profitable growth through an appropriate mix of domestic, international, premium and value-added services. Develop territory-level action plans to address revenue gaps and capitalize on emerging business opportunities. Counter Sales & Productivity Monitor commercial performance of counters within the assigned territory. Drive improvement in revenue per counter and productivity of touchpoints. Ensure counter teams actively identify customer requirements and recommend appropriate Blue Dart products and services. Promote cross-selling and up-selling of relevant premium and value-added solutions based on customer needs. Identify underperforming counters and work with relevant teams on specific improvement actions. Track counter-level trends and ensure timely corrective action where performance is below plan. Catchment & Local Market Development Develop a strong understanding of the business potential surrounding each counter. Map local catchments to identify SMEs, professionals, retailers, online sellers, institutions and other potential shipping customers. Generate new business from customers located within the counter catchment. Identify high-potential commercial clusters and local markets that can contribute incremental revenue. Conduct regular market visits and customer interactions to understand shipping requirements and generate business leads. Support local sales campaigns, activations and customer engagement initiatives to increase awareness and footfall. Customer Acquisition & Retention Drive acquisition of new and small-business customers within the assigned territory. Convert appropriate walk-in and transactional customers into repeat customers. Build relationships with high-value and frequent customers to improve retention and wallet share. Identify customer shipping patterns and proactively recommend relevant Blue Dart products and service options. Follow up on business opportunities generated through counters and local market activity. Work with Customer Service and Operations to resolve service concerns that may impact customer retention or future business. Product & Solution Selling Develop strong working knowledge of Blue Dart's domestic, international, time-definite and value-added service portfolio. Understand customer requirements relating to shipment urgency, destination, shipment characteristics and service expectations. Recommend appropriate products and solutions based on customer needs. Drive awareness and adoption of premium and value-added services across the customer base. Support rollout of new products, commercial campaigns and sales initiatives within the assigned territory. Ensure counter teams have adequate product knowledge to effectively engage and advise customers. Customer Experience & Sales Standards Ensure Sales touchpoints consistently deliver a professional and customer-focused experience. Monitor customer feedback and identify recurring issues affecting business. Coordinate with Operations and Customer Service for timely resolution of customer concerns. Ensure customers receive accurate information on products, pricing, transit commitments and shipment requirements. Support adherence to Blue Dart's brand and service standards across assigned counters. Drive repeat business through reliable service, proactive engagement and relationship building. Revenue Quality & Commercial Discipline Ensure business is acquired in accordance with approved pricing and commercial guidelines. Monitor revenue quality and avoid business that does not meet required commercial parameters. Support adherence to approved payment, billing and credit processes applicable to sales customers. Track outstanding commercial issues and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for closure. Ensure appropriate documentation and commercial controls are followed across assigned business. Market Intelligence & Competition Tracking Maintain awareness of competitor offerings, pricing, service propositions and presence within the assigned territory. Track changes in local customer behaviour and emerging shipment requirements. Identify competitive threats and opportunities impacting Blue Dart's business. Provide structured market feedback to the Cluster Manager – . Recommend local interventions to strengthen Blue Dart's market position. Sales Operations & Performance Management Maintain accurate counter-wise revenue, volume and customer acquisition data. Prepare periodic sales reports, forecasts and territory performance updates. Track performance against targets and maintain an active pipeline of local business opportunities. Ensure timely updating of customer and sales information in applicable systems. Participate in periodic business reviews with the Cluster Manager. Implement agreed action plans and track outcomes against defined timelines. Cross Functional Coordination Coordinate with Operations to ensure reliable pickup, movement and delivery of shipments. Work closely with Customer Service for timely resolution of customer queries and service issues. Liaise with Finance on billing, reconciliation and other commercial matters where required. Collaborate with regional Commercial teams on sales campaigns and market development initiatives. Work with counter and Operations teams to ensure commercial opportunities are supported by appropriate service execution. Qualifications & Experience: Education : Graduate in any discipline. MBA / PGDM in Marketing or Sales preferred. Experience : 2–4 years of experience in Sales, Territory Sales, B2C/B2B Sales, Customer Acquisition or Business Development. Experience in logistics, express distribution, courier, services, telecom, BFSI or other high-transaction customer-facing industries preferred. Experience managing sales targets across multiple customer touchpoints or a defined geographic territory will be an advantage. Exposure to counter-based sales, local market development or SME/customer acquisition will be preferred.
